{"message":"In the sandbox, the gateway enforces a rate limit of 60 requests per minute per client application. On a 429 Too Many Requests error, use exponential backoff and wait for the Retry-After header (in seconds) before retrying. Do not retry immediately. The X-Correlation-Id header is available in all responses and should be quoted when contacting support.

Rate limit: 60 requests per minute per client application.
429 handling: Exponential backoff with Retry-After header; do not retry immediately.
